# Dr. Antounios Ashraf Platform - EduSaaS

> EduSaaS is a multi-tenant American High School Mathematics platform designed for SAT, EST, and ACT test preparation, structured group learning, and academic tracking.

## Overview
- Platform Name: Dr. Antounios Ashraf Platform (EduSaaS)
- Purpose: High-school mathematics education, automated quizzes, timed exams, video lectures, and student performance metrics.
- Primary Language: Arabic (RTL) with English (LTR) mathematical terminology.
- Technology Stack: Flutter Web (CanvasKit / Wasm), Supabase PostgreSQL, Row Level Security (RLS), Cloudflare Pages / Firebase CDN.

## Key Portals
- Teacher Portal: `/teacher` - Management of student groups, academic content, assignments, attendance, and exam grades.
- Student Portal: `/student` - Access to assigned mathematical study groups, interactive practice, video materials, and results.
- Parent Portal: `/parent` - Real-time monitoring of attendance, exam scores, and student domain mastery.

## Standards & Security
- Isolation: Multi-Tenant database isolation enforced strictly via PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS).
- Integrity: Immutable historical academic snapshots for exams and submissions.
- Performance: WebAssembly-ready client runtime with responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts.
